name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Brush | Lemon Cherry Gelato
description: Experience the perfect blend of citrus zest and sweet dessert vibes with Fresh Canna’s 2G Live Resin Concentrate Brush – Lemon Cherry Gelato, a potent hybrid that combines uplifting euphoria with smooth relaxation. This precision applicator makes it effortless to enhance your dabs, joints, blunts, or bowls with pure, terp-loaded live resin. With bright lemon, sweet cherry, and creamy gelato undertones, this strain delivers an initial cerebral rush of happiness and creativity, followed by a mellow, relaxing body buzz. Whether you're kicking back or staying productive, Lemon Cherry Gelato keeps the vibes fresh and balanced.
